commitments.title: YOLO Achievement sandbox
commitments.scope: Use a temporary sandbox for the GitHub YOLO achievement without weakening production repository governance.

commitments.title: Weighted Progress Model
commitments.scope: Machine-derived, fail-closed project progress. Undefined denominators remain null rather than producing fabricated completion percentages.

commitments.title: Enterprise MITRE ATT&CK semantic upgrade
commitments.scope: Additive, versioned, non-destructive ATT&CK enrichment including Detection Strategies, Analytics, Data Components, lifecycle/versioning, provenance and regression gates while preserving identifiers, mappings and historical snapshots.

commitments.title: Deep Knowledge Integration: LOLBAS + GTFOBins + iRed.team
commitments.scope: Deep technical integration of behaviors, binaries/functions/APIs, prerequisites, artifacts, telemetry/Event IDs/Sysmon, ATT&CK, D3FEND, CAR where defensible, Detection, Hunt, Investigation and Response. Content must be independently authored with claim-level provenance, cross-validation, licensing/redistribution boundaries and no copied or close-paraphrased source text.

commitments.title: Investigation Reasoning Graph / Hypothesis Mind Map
commitments.scope: Deterministic investigation reasoning model: Event -> Hypotheses -> Evidence Needed -> Supports/Refutes -> Confidence -> ATT&CK/D3FEND -> Detection/Hunt -> Investigation -> Response. Fact, Evidence, Hypothesis, Inference and AI Suggestion must remain explicitly distinct.

commitments.title: Private ATLAS MVP-2 Analyst Preview
commitments.scope: Deliver a private Windows portable/local-offline Analyst Preview for personal/internal testing using the real Windows corpus. It must include Search, Event Detail, Provenance, Relationship Graph, Timeline, an initial deterministic Investigation Graph and canary investigations for Windows 4625, Windows 4688 and Sysmon 1. Windows Security 423/423 and Sysmon 30/30 are baseline corpus inputs; PowerShell is included when its denominator is frozen.

commitments.title: Abstract Animated ATLAS Digital Entity
commitments.scope: Non-human abstract ATLAS Entity, not a human face and not a cliche robot. Visual language may use a data orb/digital face, transparent hands and node-particles. MVP-2 receives a simple meaningful locally rendered version tied to real engine states rather than decoration.

commitments.title: ATLAS Entity Evolution Track
commitments.scope: Continue post-MVP evolution of the ATLAS Digital Entity in abstraction, motion, interaction, graph integration, visual intelligence and responsive behavior.

commitments.title: Cyber-Sentinel private-by-default development and release governance
commitments.scope: All MVPs, prototypes, test builds and test artifacts across ATLAS, DefenseOps and Skills remain private/non-public by default. Public release requires explicit Product Owner approval after licensing and release requirements are satisfied.

commitments.title: Cyber-Sentinel public profile and README redesign
commitments.scope: Redesign the public Cyber-Sentinel profile/README with technical positioning and infographics for ecosystem architecture, ATLAS thesis, Investigation Graph, trust pipeline, product loop and local/offline architecture.

commitments.title: GitHub achievements are secondary to real engineering
commitments.scope: Pursue GitHub achievements only when they occur naturally through real, high-quality engineering work; never distort product engineering merely to obtain an achievement.

commitments.title: Universal TelemetryRecordType abstraction
commitments.scope: Platform -> Product -> TelemetryProvider -> TelemetrySource -> TelemetryRecordType with Event, AuditRecord, Operation, Activity, Finding and FlowRecord specializations. Artifact and Behavior remain separate concepts.

commitments.title: Windows mandatory telemetry families
commitments.scope: Security-Auditing, Sysmon, PowerShell Operational, Windows Defender, AppLocker/WDAC, WMI Activity, Task Scheduler Operational, RDP/Terminal Services, Windows Firewall/Filtering Platform, DNS Client/Server and service/process persistence telemetry with explicit provider/channel/version denominators.

commitments.title: Windows analyst knowledge relationships
commitments.scope: MITRE ATT&CK, selected D3FEND/CAR where defensible, controlled DefenseOps detections/hunts, investigation/DFIR pivots and source/provenance metadata.

commitments.title: Universal domain expansion
commitments.scope: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, DevOps/CI-CD, Microsoft 365/Exchange/SharePoint, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, MongoDB and other databases, using the universal telemetry model, cross-platform correlation, pack-based content and offline-first delivery.

commitments.title: Approved ATLAS product family
commitments.scope: Desktop Windows/Linux/macOS; CLI Windows/Linux/macOS; Web; iOS Safari PWA; API; native Mobile iOS/Android. Windows Desktop is current release-critical surface.

commitments.title: Cyber-Sentinel operating model
commitments.scope: ATLAS=KNOW, DefenseOps=DEFEND, Skills=APPLY with operating loop KNOW -> DEFEND -> APPLY -> VALIDATE -> AUTOMATE -> EVOLVE.
